The first term is $500$ and the common ratio is $\dfrac25$.

:-: |  :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-:
$500,$ | | $200,$ | | $80,$ | | $32,...$

This is the recursive formula of $500\,,\,200\,,\,80\,,\,32,...$.

$\begin{cases}
c(1)=500
\\\\
c(n)=c(n-1)\cdot\dfrac25
\end{cases}$
